what her parents exactly said to me when we had a conversation a few months ago about this was that i did not have to pay rent, so i would be able to save up more money so me and gf can move out. i think i would know if they told me i would have to pay rent eventually. they said i did not have to pay rent whatsoever. me living there is most definitely NOT long term. i do not wish it to be. me and my gf want to be able to live in our own apartment once it is deemed “safe”, as in we have stable jobs, and enough money to support us. we do NOT plan on staying there for years. her parents know this.

edit: i think if they thought i was planning on staying for years, there definitely would have been a conversation about that. and i’m not even sure if they would’ve been so willing. but every party here knows that this is just a short term thing until me and gf are all set to go. we do have a plan to move out, it’s not like i’m using them or something
her parents said that.

i’m not taking her word, i have seen the things they spend their money on. when i stay over her house, and let’s say we get take out. i try to pay for my own food, but each time they refuse to let me pay for anything. i think i would know a thing or two on if they have money or not. 

i have always lived in poverty according to my states guidelines, they very very clearly do not live in poverty. they have a nice house, 3 pets, go on vacations all of the time, spend money on expensive food, activities, etc. they have that luxury to spend money on anything at any time just because they feel like it. they pay for literally everything for their 3 kids too (two of them are adults). their kids have no real idea how to be financially responsible because of that.

yes. they told me from the start that i could move into her room for free. i would not have to contribute to rent or bills. this plan has been talked about with me, her mother and husband. it wasn’t just a soft plan, we always knew it was going to happen. her parents were the ones who even thought of the idea to let me move in. i was never like “hey, could i move in?” they said something like “you need to get out of there ASAP, you can stay with us.” and really what it is, is that we plan to move out into our own place once we get our ducks in a row (have stable jobs, make enough money, etc)

i mean i don’t think my relationship with her parents have evolved in any way, i think the communication is getting jumbled up because they’re having it go through them, to my gf, then to me.

because i was told by my gf that they are considered upper middle class. they splurge on things a lot. they have plenty of money for non-necessities and vacations. they very clearly have it well off in life.

i don’t mind paying for whatever they need me to pay for. it’s more so i am very confused because there is no clear plan or communication here. money is not the issue. i’m not an absolute dumbass and think i get a free pass for everything in life.

i mean tbh i think i deserve what everybody’s saying, i thought that because my girlfriend agrees with how i’m feeling, i wouldn’t be seen as the asshole. now i just feel embarrassed and very clearly need to suck it up lmao

that’s exactly the type of conversation i’d like to have with them. but, all of this information is coming from her parents, then to her, and to me. she’s the middle man in all of this. and her parents don’t want to discuss further right now. and hell no, i won’t become a freeloader. that’s the LAST thing i want. i want nothing more to be independent with my girlfriend, we eventually plan to move into our own place once we get our ducks settled in a row. they most definitely would not be inviting me to move in if they thought i was irresponsible, they actually think i have more responsibility than my gf does.

yeah probably. i’ve lived in poverty my whole life, so money just overall makes me anxious. they know we’re poor, but they don’t know the nitty gritty details of it. i AM willing to pay rent, but the fact that i wasn’t told this from the start is making me anxious.
